g.text: Base: PR base ffe2db3 · PR: PR 3c69277
Each field/curve: maximum relative L2 across selected views; repeat-noise curves are separate within-variant comparisons.
Display floor: 1e−16 only; zeros remain zero in the data, not measured 1e−16. MP = width × height / 1e6. Lines connect measured points only.
